done_when: A story's plan read stops after two rounds that have no blocking notes on new text, and an edit only below For the builders never asks for another read

findings.body: Raise: Functional. The new cap permits blocking only on the story diff or an unresolved finding. On a third round, the confirmed spec or `docs/product/BRIEF.md` Answers can change between reads while the relevant story text stays unchanged. The same prompt requires the reader to check those changes (lines 145–150), but this cap makes a newly conflicting plan requirement advisory, allowing the read to pass without resolving it. The changed-spec path is exercised in `tests/test_readloop_rounds.py:509`.
findings.title: Round-three cap downgrades conflicts from changed spec and Answers text

why: Plan reads loop for many rounds (21 on one story), each round an exchange with the owner
